name: Nori Pridedrift
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Nori Pridedrift carries steaming Mornbrew to those facing the cold. He makes his living brewing and selling the hot drink, and hires swift couriers to deliver it while it is still warm.

sections.title: A Steaming Cup in the Snow
sections.body: Nori Pridedrift sends hot Mornbrew across the frozen reaches of Coldridge Valley. The valley's cold bites hard, and a draught of Scalding Mornbrew offers welcome warmth. Nori brews the coffee-like drink and sends it to mountaineers and freezing sentries. It must reach them while still scalding, so his couriers race against the mountain air. Nori also has only a limited supply of sturdy mugs, and expects runners to bring them back promptly.

faq.answer: Nori Pridedrift is a dwarf peddler in Coldridge Valley. He brews and sells Scalding Mornbrew, a hot, coffee-like drink for the local guards and miners.
Scalding Mornbrew is a hot drink brewed by Nori Pridedrift. Valley folk favor it for warming them against the bitter cold of Dun Morogh.

aliases: why does the drink go cold
faq.answer: Deliveries are urgent because Scalding Mornbrew is prized while piping hot. Coldridge Valley's mountain winds cool each cup quickly, so Nori's couriers must hurry to their customers.

faq.q: Why does Nori care so much about returning mugs?
faq.answer: Nori has only a limited supply of drinking mugs in the valley. If customers keep them or break them in the snow, his morning trade soon falters.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the comfort of a strong drink in freezing weather. Nori's hot Mornbrew is welcome on mountain watch posts.
As a cook in Dun Morogh, you can appreciate Nori's care in serving his specialty drink piping hot in the freezing air.
